summary: Practise tax expenditure inventory, cost estimation and reporting. Build practical fiscal analysis skills. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Tax expenditure analysis helps public finance officials and revenue-policy analysts identify tax preferences and assess their revenue and distributional effects. The training also suits budget advisers who review these estimates, and builds practical skills in defining a benchmark tax system, creating an inventory, and applying the revenue forgone method. Participants practise checking data and cost calculations, assessing beneficiary groups, and preparing transparent reporting and periodic review proposals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public finance and revenue-policy professionals who assess tax incentives, prepare fiscal analysis, or scrutinize tax expenditure reporting.
modules: Tax Expenditure Scope and Fiscal Context
prerequisites: Working knowledge of public budgeting, tax policy, or tax administration is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with the tax measures or reporting processes relevant to your work; advanced topics such as microsimulation and AI-assisted screening are introduced conceptually.
